out.detail: upper body injury; needs more practice time before returning, will miss his eighth straight game

away.summary: The Sharks (7-8-1) head to Los Angeles with a projected lineup featuring Yaroslav Askarov as the first-listed goalie. Alexander Wennberg remains out for an eighth straight game with an upper-body injury, while Igor Chernyshov is also injured. Adam Gaudette and Nolan Allan are scratched, and Dmitry Orlov is paired with Eric Pohlkamp, who is set to make his NHL debut after recall from the AHL.

out.detail: undisclosed injury; returned to practice but remains week to week, has not played since Oct. 6

home.summary: The Kings (4-7-2) are projected to start Darcy Kuemper in net. Adrian Kempe returns to the lineup after missing the Oct. 31 game versus Buffalo with an undisclosed injury. Cody Ceci and Samuel Helenius are scratched, while Alex Turcotte (week to week), Kevin Fiala (leg surgery), and Mats Zuccarello (upper body) are out.
